edges.reason: transfer forwards to the internal _transfer function.
transferFrom forwards to the internal _transfer function.
approve writes the spender allowance into _allowances.
_transfer dispatches to _tokenTransfer for accounting.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call before state settlement.
_transfer triggers sendETHToCorona which performs ETH transfers to external wallets.
_transfer reads _maxTxAmount to enforce the transfer limit.
_transfer reads _isExcludedFromFee to decide fee exemption.
_transfer reads the inSwap guard flag to avoid circular swap during an active swap.
swapTokensForEth passes token amount and path into the external Uniswap router call.
sendETHToCorona forwards computed amounts into the ETH transfer operation.
manualSwap calls swapTokensForEth with the whole contract balance.
manualSend calls sendETHToCorona with the whole contract ETH balance.
setSwapEnabled writes the swapEnabled flag.
lock moves _owner into _previousOwner and zeroes it.
lock writes _lockTime from the block timestamp plus duration.
unlock restores _owner from _previousOwner based on timestamp checks.
unlock compares block timestamp against _lockTime.
renounceOwnership sets _owner to the zero address.
transferOwnership sets _owner to the new owner address.
excludeAccount marks the account as excluded in _isExcluded.
includeAccount clears the _isExcluded flag for the account.
includeAccount mutates the _excluded array via swap-and-pop.
setMaxTxPercent recomputes _maxTxAmount from total supply and percent.
_setCoronaWallet replaces the Corona wallet address.
_setTaxFee writes the tax fee used in value computations.
_setCoronaFee writes the Corona fee used in value computations.
_tokenTransfer routes to _transferStandard when neither party is excluded.
_tokenTransfer branches on the _isExcluded flags of sender and recipient.
_transferStandard calls _takeCorona with the Corona fee portion.
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee with the reflection fee.
_transferStandard debits and credits _rOwned balances.
_takeCorona credits the contract address in _rOwned.
_reflectFee subtracts the reflection fee from _rTotal.
_reflectFee adds the token fee to _tFeeTotal.
_getValues delegates fee splitting to _getTValues.
_getValues reads the current reflection rate via _getRate.
_getValues consumes _taxFee for value computation.
_getValues consumes _CoronaFee for value computation.
_getRate obtains supplies from _getCurrentSupply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _rTotal as the starting reflection supply.
_getCurrentSupply reads _tTotal as the starting token supply.
deliver subtracts computed reflections from the caller in _rOwned.
deliver reduces _rTotal by the reflection amount.
setExcludeFromFee writes the _isExcludedFromFee flag for an account.
balanceOf converts reflections to tokens using the current rate.
transfer uses the caller address as the sender of funds.
_transfer derives sender from the caller-controlled address.
lock is reachable only when the caller equals _owner.
unlock requires the caller to equal _previousOwner.
excludeAccount authorization depends on the caller identity.
constructor assigns the initial reflection balance to the deployer/caller.
swapTokensForEth uses block.timestamp as the Uniswap swap deadline.
lock derives _lockTime from the current block timestamp.
unlock depends on the block timestamp exceeding _lockTime.
Router external call can re-enter the transfer flow while inSwap is set and balances are unsettled.
ETH transfer to fee wallets can invoke receiver fallback and re-enter the transfer flow.
recipient parameter flows into the transfer accounting.
amount parameter is compared to _maxTxAmount and split into fee components.
time parameter is added to the block timestamp for the lock duration.
account parameter is written into the exclusion mappings and array.
maxTxPercent parameter scales total supply into the max transfer amount.
tAmount parameter is decomposed into fee, Corona and transfer amounts.
contractTokenBalance local decides whether the automatic swap branch runs.
takeFee local controls whether fees are removed for the transfer.
path local supplies the token/WETH swap route to the router call.
currentRate local converts Corona token fee into reflections.

normalization_plan.reason: Recipient parameter is only meaningful inside the transfer accounting logic.
Amount parameter is consumed entirely by _transfer validation and fee splitting.
Lock duration parameter exists only to compute _lockTime inside lock().
Account parameter is used only to update exclusion state in excludeAccount().
Percentage parameter exists only to recompute _maxTxAmount in setMaxTxPercent().
Token amount parameter is decomposed only within _getValues().
Temporary balance local used only for the swap threshold decision in _transfer.
Temporary fee flag computed and used only within the transfer flow.
Swap path array exists only as an argument to the router call.
Cached reflection rate is used only inside _takeCorona.
